paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: Christ is the real thing, and the food, drink and calendar rules are the shadow. Paul says food, drink, feasts, New Moons and Sabbaths are "a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ." (Colossians 2:17) So when somebody sizes you up over your plate or your calendar, they're arguing about the smell of the cookies while the whole batch sits right there, and you can just take the batch.

Now look at where the growing comes from. The person Paul warns about has "lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow." (Colossians 2:19) That's the whole difference, friend. Rules can LOOK wise, Paul says, with all their "Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!" (Colossians 2:21), but they are "of no value against the indulgence of the flesh." (Colossians 2:23)

So here's what I want you to carry out of my bakery. You died with Christ (Colossians 2:20), so you don't have to live like a person still trying to earn a spot with a list of human commands. Stay connected to the Head, and let God do the growing. Nobody in your group chat gets to hand you a rulebook and call it holiness, and that includes me, friend, because I'm just a stamper on a gold base.
